feature: Cron refresh data VIP vehicle dari CAS ke tabel ocms_vip_vehicle (harian 02:00)
note: Cron ini memperbarui daftar VIP yang dipakai untuk menandai notice bertipe V. Dipakai sebagai prasyarat OCMS14.26 tetapi tidak ada story yang secara eksplisit meminta sinkronisasi dari CAS. Isi API CAS cannot verify from repo.
note_en: This cron refreshes the VIP list used to mark notices as type V. It is used as a prerequisite of OCMS14.26 but no story explicitly asks for the CAS synchronisation. The CAS API content cannot be verified from the repo.

feature: CRUD staff API untuk tabel ocms_vip_vehicle (/vipvehicle)
note: Endpoint CRUD generik untuk daftar VIP vehicle. Tidak ada layar di ocmsadminui yang memakainya (pencarian 'vipvehicle' di ocmsadminui/src kosong); OCMS-SR-2026-051 menunjukkan perubahan data dilakukan lewat patch DB.
note_en: Generic CRUD endpoint for the VIP vehicle list. No screen in ocmsadminui uses it (a search for 'vipvehicle' in ocmsadminui/src is empty); OCMS-SR-2026-051 shows data changes are done through DB patches.

feature: Re-apply PS-FOR untuk kendaraan asing yang masih unpaid saat Toppan letter generation
note: Notice kendaraan asing yang kehilangan PS-FOR dan belum dibayar disuspend lagi saat letter generation (applyPsSuspensionForForeignVehicles). Berkaitan dengan OCMS14.30 yang Removed: furnish driver untuk kendaraan asing bisa dibatalkan efeknya oleh re-apply ini. Tidak diklaim.
note_en: Foreign-vehicle notices that lost PS-FOR and are still unpaid are suspended again during letter generation (applyPsSuspensionForForeignVehicles). Related to the Removed OCMS14.30: a driver furnish for a foreign vehicle can be undone by this re-apply. Not claimed.

feature: Jalur manual furnish officer (/furnish/officer/manual/single, check-existing, furnishable) tanpa pemanggil di staff portal
note: Endpoint ini tidak memblokir PS aktif (hanya cek stage) sehingga mampu mem-furnish notice kendaraan asing, tetapi pencarian 'furnish/officer/manual' di ocmsadminui/src kosong. Mirip OCMS14.30 (Removed); tidak diklaim.
note_en: This endpoint does not block on an active PS (stage check only) so it can furnish a foreign-vehicle notice, but a search for 'furnish/officer/manual' in ocmsadminui/src is empty. Similar to OCMS14.30 (Removed); not claimed.
